method: Supervised coarse-to-fine RGB localization. Frozen r3 coarse CNN selects native 256-pixel crops; 257-pixel receptive-field CNN predicts Gaussian rim-center heatmap with soft-argmax subpixel coordinates. Heatmap cross-entropy plus 0.02 smooth-L1 coordinate loss. Equal size/episode sampling, integer translations and brightness augmentation. No ground-truth crops at inference; no RL or active model change.
